title: Plato's cave: someone outside the cave pulling us through

tellings.quote: like it would seem there has to be somebody outside of the cave doing this. Like there has somebody has to from the perspective of enlightenment be pulling us through.

plain: Plato's famous image in The Republic of people chained in a cave, who must be led out to see the truth, implies according to a guest named James Madden that 'there has to be somebody outside of the cave' doing the leading. Madden, speaking with Michels about consciousness and UFOs, reads the story himself and says that from the point of view of enlightenment someone 'has to be pulling us through'. Read his way, the old allegory would point to an outside intelligence guiding human beings toward understanding.
